_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score has moved ±2+ points in 0 of 39 windows — this is a textbook coil and HOLD is the statistically honest call until a confirmed breaker appears; the analyst's 0-for-18 forced-direction record in exactly this regime is the clincher.
next_move.brains_agree: No — narrative implies bullish reversal ahead while analyst explicitly calls HOLD; I side with the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and the crushing coil evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX drops below 14 AND DXY breaks below 99.5 AND btc_momentum_30d sustains above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding rises above 0.015% with DXY reclaiming 100.5 and exchange_netflow flipping above 60
